summary: This note is the source of the rospy numpy_msg module, a ROS Python library file that lets rospy messages use numpy arrays for numerical data. It carries a BSD license from Willow Garage, Inc. (2009) and a docstring with listener and publisher usage examples. The code defines serialize and deserialize wrappers that pass the numpy module into generated message methods, and a numpy_msg() factory that builds and caches a subclass named Numpy_ plus the message type name with slashes replaced by double underscores.
one_line: Source code for rospy's numpy_msg module, which lets ROS Python publishers and subscribers exchange numpy arrays as message data.
key_facts: The file is licensed under the BSD License and its copyright is held by Willow Garage, Inc., dated 2009.
The module's docstring says that tutorials are at http://wiki.ros.org/rospy_tutorials/Tutorials/numpy.
The listener example imports numpy_msg from rospy.numpy_msg and subscribes with rospy.Subscriber("mytopic", numpy_msg(TopicType)).
The publisher example creates pub = rospy.Publisher('mytopic', numpy_msg(TopicType), queue_size=10).
The publisher example builds the array numpy.array([1.0, 2.1, 3.2, 4.3, 5.4, 6.5], dtype=numpy.float32) and publishes it with pub.publish(a).
The _serialize_numpy wrapper returns self.serialize_numpy(buff, numpy), passing the numpy module in to avoid an import in auto-generated code.
The _deserialize_numpy wrapper returns self.deserialize_numpy(str, numpy) and follows the same pattern.
A code comment notes a TODO: a new type structure with little-endian specified must be generated and passed into the *_numpy calls.
The numpy_msg(msg_type) function returns a cached class from the _numpy_msg_types dictionary when one exists.
numpy_msg() builds a classdict copying __slots__, _slot_types, _md5sum, _type, _has_header and _full_text from the message type.
The generated class name is "Numpy_%s" with '/' in the message type replaced by '__'.
The new class is created with type(msg_type_name, (msg_type,), classdict), so it subclasses the original message type.
The docstring marks the msg_type parameter as the message class passed into a Publisher or Subscriber call and the return value as a Message class.
